title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Prior Authorization and Referral Grid
content:
Whether an affirmed prior authorization or a primary-care referral is needed depends on the payer class of the patient's **Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility** record. The grid shows each class's requirement by equipment line, then the decision and validity periods of its prior-authorization program.

## Requirements by equipment line

| Payer class | Power mobility devices (before delivery) | PAP devices (before setup) | Home oxygen (before setup) | Hospital beds and powered support surfaces (before delivery) | Urological supply programs (before the first shipment) | Primary-care referral on file before DME is billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | required | not required | not required | not required | not required | not required |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | required | required | required | required | not required | required |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | required | not required | not required | not required | not required | not required |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | required | required | not required | required | required | not required |
| Commercial HMO | required | required | required | required | not required | required |
| Commercial PPO | required | not required | not required | not required | not required | not required |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | not required | not required | not required | not required | not required | not required |

## Decision and validity periods

| Payer class | Standard request decided within (calendar days after receipt) | Expedited request decided within (hours) | Affirmed authorization usable for delivery (calendar days from decision date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 10 | 48 | 120 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 7 | 72 | 90 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 7 | 72 | 90 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 7 | 72 | 180 |
| Commercial HMO | 15 | 72 | 60 |
| Commercial PPO | 15 | 72 | 90 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 0 | 0 | 0 |

A 0 in any of the three period columns means the class runs no prior-authorization program; Medicare Supplement Plan G is the only class showing 0.

## Notes on the grid

- "Required" in the first table means an affirmed prior authorization is required before the event named in the column heading (delivery, setup or first shipment).
- The referral column records whether a primary-care referral must be on file before DME is billed to the class; only the two HMO classes, Medicare Advantage HMO and Commercial HMO, require it.
- Hypothetical illustration: an authorization affirmed by a Commercial HMO payer stays usable for delivery for 60 calendar days counted from its decision date; the same affirmation from a Medicaid Fee-for-Service payer stays usable for 180.
